_note: LVL-04a: Level 1-4 beats 1 to 5. One run north: the forecourt, explore 1, the A4 hall, the alcove off the corridor past it, and the A8 bridge over the ring. LVL-04b stage 1: the Pit and breather 2. LVL-04b stage 2: the mini-boss Ring, with its two promoted Darters and the Swarmers that arrive at half their health, and the temporary exit pad moved past it. Metres, Y up, -z is north, positions are box centres.
_notes: forecourt: no foam dummy is a placeable thing (only waves spawn Foamers, and a wave would lock the court), so the four the card asks for are small voxel foam-white pieces at 4, 6, 10 and 15 m from the start. They carve like any cover and cannot shoot back.

explore-1: the Darter stands at the room's north wall, 16 m from the room's south door and 30 m from the forecourt's north door, which is the concept's 30 m first sight line down the corridor. The arena locks as 1-3's explore room does, which needs no change to the runner.
room pillars: 1.6 x 1.6 x 2.8 m, KIT 5's cover pillar, so the card's 1.6 m pillars are its full height (a 1.6 m pillar would be under the player's 1.6 m eye height and hide nothing).

hall: six columns 8 m apart, staggered 6 m either side of the centre lane, west at z -65, -81, -97 (3.2 m voxel foam zones) and east at z -73, -89, -105 (4 m shell). The lock trigger is 18 m in, the card's and the concept's number; at 8 m spacing that is the third column, not the fourth, so the trigger follows the 18 m.

hall waves: a wave's rift list is one slot per Foamer, taken in turn, so a repeated id weights that rift. Wave 1 is 4 Swarmers from the floor rift 29 m up the hall, then 1 Darter from the north wall; wave 2 is 4 Roamers from the west wall, then 2 Darters from the north and east rifts. 5 then 6 alive.

hall charge line: the centre lane between the two column rows is clear from the south door to the north wall, 40 m, so a Darter has well over its 18 m run; the columns sit 6 m either side of it as the player's sidestep.

alcove: the U1 station is [Paul] and not built; the foam-yellow floor marking at [7, -113] marks its empty spot. It opens off the corridor past the hall's north door, which is the concept's map (U1 / A2 between the hall and the bridge) and keeps the station out of the locked hall. No ammo here: A2 is at column 3.

bridge: two 16 x 16 m yards and a 4 x 24 m deck at 0, 9 m over an 8 m wide ring at -9, no rails. There are no doors and noLock is set: the fight starts on entering the near yard, the way on is the drop, and entering the ring ends the arena (escape) whether or not a Darter is up.

bridge way down: the blast wall the card says hides the way down stands over a 3.2 m hole in the near yard's floor at x 1.6..4, z -131..-127.8, which drops to the ring; the second blast wall is the S2 spot, [Paul], its lime marking at [-6.3, -131] beside it. Dropping off the deck's side is the other way down, as the concept's jump off the bridge is.
no fall damage: data/player.json has no fall damage setting (only maxFallSpeed 40), so the 9 m drop to the ring is survivable and is the level's intended way on.

exit: a plain pad on the ring at [0, -9, -147], under the bridge. It is temporary: the Pit, breather 2, the mini-boss Ring, the Yard and the lift are a later card, and the pad stands where that way on begins.
B03: the arena page builds the loadout from data/blasters.json, which already lists B03 third, so the level starts with it in hand; no blaster pickup is built (PLAN.md section 14, LVL-04a).
S1: the broken wall is [Paul] and not built; the lime marking at [5.4, -44] is on the room's east wall behind the east cover pillar, where the concept puts it.
nothing is scaled down: the forecourt is 14 x 20 m, the hall 18 x 44 m with a 7 m ceiling, the alcove 8 x 8 m, the yards 16 x 16 m and the bridge 4 x 24 m, all as the card gives them.

ring (A2): 30 x 30 m, 8 m to the ceiling, a 10 x 8 m centre block 3.5 m tall and a 6 m ring round it. Entry from breather 2 on the south wall, exit on the north wall, which is also where 1-3's ring puts its way on; the concept's four shutters are two doors here because the room is a through-room, not a dead end (PLAN.md section 14).

ring waves: two promoted Darters (45 health each) from the opposite west and east rifts. The six Swarmers come out of two floor rifts when the living Darters hold 50% of the health the wave started with (Wave.startsWithHealthShare), so the fight scales with how fast the pair is hurt; if both die first the wave still starts, at its 0 s delay.
ring pillars: four 1.6 x 1.6 x 2.8 m foam-orange voxel pieces at the corners of the ring, 3.5 m clear of both floor rifts, so carving them opens the loop the concept describes.
ammo: A4, 10 shells, in the west ring; A5, 6 shells, on the centre block's top.
